title.sl: Novi kandidati in rezultati zunaj skupne lestvice
title.en: New candidates and results outside the overall ranking

scope.sl: Osvežitev 23. 11. 2026. Številčne ocene in skupna lestvica ostajajo iz zadnjega celotnega ciljnega zajema R3 z dne 20. 11. 2026. GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol in Gemini 4 Neon so že vključeni v R3; R3 zajema tudi osvežitev Arena Agent Index do 19. 11. 2026. Spodaj ločujemo specializirane modele, razvojne rezultate, ki jih poroča njihov avtor, in rezultate celotnih agentnih sistemov. Teh ne mešamo v skupno lestvico posameznih osnovnih modelov, dokler primerljivost in neodvisna pokritost nista ustrezni.
scope.en: Updated 23 Nov 2026. Numeric scores and the overall ranking remain from the latest full targeted R3 capture dated 20 Nov 2026. GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol and Gemini 4 Neon are already included in R3; R3 also includes the Arena Agent Index refresh through 19 Nov 2026. The items below separate specialized models, developer-reported research results, and complete agent systems. They are not mixed into the single-base-model ranking until comparability and independent coverage are adequate.

summary.sl: Splošno razpoložljiv od 17. 11. 2026. Namenjen je strukturiranim odločitvam, usmerjanju, klasifikaciji in preverjanju z umerjeno stopnjo zaupanja, ne splošnemu klepetu. Microsoft poroča rezultat 68/100 na neodvisnem Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1. Ker ta indeks meri drugačen tip nalog kot naš splošni LLM meta-indeks, model spremljamo ločeno. Microsoft Foundry Global Standard: $0,042 na milijon vhodnih žetonov; izhod je brezplačen.
summary.en: Generally available since 17 Nov 2026. It is designed for structured decisions, routing, classification and verification with calibrated confidence, rather than general chat. Microsoft reports 68/100 on the independently run Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1. Because that index measures a different task class from our general LLM meta-index, we track this model separately. Microsoft Foundry Global Standard: $0.042 per million input tokens; output is free.

label.sl: Nov odprtokodni kandidat · čaka na neodvisno potrditev
label.en: New open-weight candidate · awaiting independent validation

summary.sl: RadixArk ga je objavil 18. 11. 2026; temelji na Qwen3.8-27B, uteži so objavljene pod Apache 2.0. Ekipa poroča 12,0 % pass@1 na Terminal-Bench 4.1 v primerjavi s 5,6 % za osnovni Qwen3.8-27B. To je rezultat razvijalca, ki ga nismo neodvisno ponovili; pass@1 tudi ni samodejno primerljiv z uradno leaderboard metriko brez uskladitve nalog, harness-a in pravil ocenjevanja. Zato ga spremljamo, vendar mu še ne pripisujemo meta-ocene ali mesta.
summary.en: Released by RadixArk on 18 Nov 2026; built on Qwen3.8-27B, with checkpoints under Apache 2.0. The team reports 12.0% pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 4.1 versus 5.6% for the base Qwen3.8-27B. This is a developer-reported result that we have not independently reproduced; pass@1 is not automatically comparable to the official leaderboard metric without matching tasks, harness and scoring rules. We therefore track it but do not assign a meta-score or rank yet.

label.en: System-level result · not a single model

summary.sl: Uradna lestvica Terminal-Bench 4.1 prikazuje 71,2 % ± 2,9 pri uporabi GitHub Copilot agenta (66 nalog). Fusion je sistem za izbiro in koordinacijo modelov; GitHub med razpoložljivimi modeli navaja Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra in MAI-Code-2. Rezultat je pomemben za primerjavo agentnih sistemov, ni pa pošteno, da ga vnesemo kot rezultat enega osnovnega LLM-ja v skupno lestvico.
summary.en: The official Terminal-Bench 4.1 leaderboard shows 71.2% ± 2.9 with the GitHub Copilot agent (66 tasks). Fusion is a model-selection and orchestration system; GitHub lists Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra and MAI-Code-2 among the available models. This is important evidence for comparing agent systems, but it should not be entered as the score of one base LLM in the overall ranking.

label.en: Outside the general LLM index scope

summary.sl: 20. 11. 2026 je bil dodan na Arena Text-to-Image lestvico. Gre za model za generiranje slik, zato ga ne vključujemo v primerjavo splošnih besedilnih LLM-jev.
summary.en: Added to Arena's Text-to-Image leaderboard on 20 Nov 2026. It is an image-generation model, so it is not included in the comparison of general-purpose text LLMs.
